```python
def crossover(parent1, parent2):
    # Hybrid crossover
    if rng.random() < 0.4:  # Arithmetic crossover
        child = [ (p1 + p2)/2 for p1, p2 in zip(parent1, parent2) ]
    else:  # Geometric crossover
        child = [ p1 * (p2>0.5) or p2 * (p1>0.5) for p1, p2 in zip(parent1, parent2) ]
    child = normalize_sequence(child, len(child))
    return child
```
